evidence.title: Microsoft Corporation 10-Q filed 2023-10-24
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target-quarter YoY revenue growth was 12.76 percent and growth acceleration was 4.422 percentage points; it resolved to 'above recent range'.

evidence.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Q1 earnings report 2024
evidence.summary: This source directly reports Microsoft's Q1 FY2024 (ending September 30, 2023) revenue and year-over-year growth, which is the core of the resolved outcome. It also breaks down revenue by segment and highlights key growth drivers like Azure and AI.

evidence.title: No 3T23, Microsoft (MSFT34) mantém capacidade de gerar caixa, sustentada pela computação em nuvem
evidence.summary: This source provides a detailed breakdown of Microsoft's Q1 FY2024 earnings, confirming the overall revenue growth and highlighting the significant contribution of the Intelligent Cloud segment, particularly Azure, to this growth.

evidence.title: Microsoft Scores Huge Earnings Surprise, Enterprise Dominating Growth - 24/7 Wall St.
evidence.summary: While the article's content is from 2013, its title and publication date on the exact resolution date suggest it might have been an early report on the earnings, indicating a positive surprise. However, the content is not available to confirm its relevance to the 2023 Q1 earnings.

evidence.title: Microsoft Q4 Preview: Cloud Will Blow Past $30 Billion
evidence.summary: This article provides a preview of Microsoft's Q4 FY2023 earnings (ending June 30, 2023) and forecasts for cloud revenue, highlighting the 'AI boom' as an accelerator. This sets the stage for the strong cloud performance seen in the subsequent Q1 FY2024.

evidence.title: Transcript : Microsoft Corporation, Q4 2023 Earnings Call, Jul 25, 2023
evidence.summary: This is a transcript of Microsoft's Q4 FY2023 earnings call, which would have included forward-looking statements and discussions about trends impacting the upcoming Q1 FY2024, such as cloud growth and AI investments.

evidence.title: Can Microsoft recover from the collapse of its Surface business? | ZDNET
evidence.summary: This article discusses the decline in Microsoft's Devices revenue, particularly the Surface business, and projects continued declines for the quarter ending September 30, 2023. This represents a countervailing factor to the overall revenue growth.

evidence.title: Is It Too Late to Buy Microsoft Stock? | The Motley Fool
evidence.summary: This article discusses the decline in Microsoft's 'more personal computing' segment during FY2023 and the broader PC market slump, which would have impacted the Q1 FY2024 results. However, it also notes the expected refresh cycle in 2024, suggesting a potential future recovery.
